versions.changelog:
- Initial release of anti-detect-browser skill.
- Enables launching Chromium instances with real-device fingerprints via standard Playwright APIs, supporting persistent, isolated profiles per identity.
- Integrates per-profile proxies that automatically set timezone and WebRTC according to the proxy exit IP.
- Provides drop-in npm (Node >= 18) and PyPI (Python 3.9–3.13) SDKs for seamless integration.
- Profiles are unlimited and locally stored; plans restrict concurrent browsers, not identities.
- Supports Windows, macOS, Linux x64/arm64, and Docker, with simple environment-based credential management.
